foregroundControl.requested: createBrowserTab visible=true before the first replay
foregroundControl.scope: recorded document visibility only; visible is not a guarantee of presentation or window focus

collection.mode: bounded foreground UI calls; complete result saved before restoration
collection.backgroundHelper: unsupported execution context; helper error preserved separately, game/probe remained running with no speed changes or pauses
collection.checkpointScope: live/start/progress and tool errors are excluded from complete nine-run inputs
collection.endScope: probe automatically stops after replay comparison; poll interval does not extend cutoff time

acceptancePolicy: measurement-policy.json; thresholds unchanged after measurement start
